title: Rethinking Visual Reasoning in Text-to-Image Reward Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2611.17585v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reward models are a core component of modern text-to-image systems, serving as the objective for inference-time selection and RL-based post-training. A key prerequisite is visual understanding: to judge prompt adherence and ground aesthetic preferences, a reward model must bind attributes, resolve relations, and count reliably. We find that widely-used reward models perform poorly on targeted visual reasoning evaluations. Even when starting from strong vision-language backbones, preference fine-tuning erodes these capabilities, and continual-learning baselines fail to mitigate a steep tradeoff between visual reasoning and preference accuracy. We propose a data-centric intervention that injects visual reasoning supervision into preference learning by flipping the pairing axis. translated_title: 重新思考文本到图像奖励建模中的视觉推理
translated_abstract: 奖励模型是现代文本到图像系统的核心组件，作为推理时选择和基于强化学习后训练的优化目标。一个关键前提是视觉理解能力：为了判断提示词遵循程度并支撑审美偏好，奖励模型必须能够可靠地绑定属性、解析关系和进行计数。我们发现，广泛使用的奖励模型在针对性的视觉推理评估中表现不佳。即使从强大的视觉语言骨干模型出发，偏好微调也会侵蚀这些能力，而持续学习基线方法无法缓解视觉推理与偏好准确性之间的严重权衡。我们提出了一种以数据为中心的干预方法，通过翻转配对轴将视觉推理监督注入偏好学习中。为了补充传统的人类偏好数据（即在共享提示词下配对的图像），我们将现有的视觉推理数据集转换为偏好对……
tldr: 该论文发现现有文本到图像奖励模型在视觉推理上表现不佳且偏好微调会损害这类能力，提出通过将视觉推理数据集转换为偏好对，以数据中心化的方式将视觉推理监督注入偏好学习。
en_tdlr: This paper finds that widely-used text-to-image reward models perform poorly on visual reasoning and preference fine-tuning erodes such capabilities, proposing a data-centric intervention that converts visual reasoning datasets into preference pairs to inject visual reasoning supervision into preference learning.
